content: Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Tani Gibxe kawo bolla ooththanayssa neni ha7i beyana; ta wolqqama qese gaason izi istta yeddana; ta wolqqama qeseppe dendidayssan izi istta ba biittafe kessi gooddana» gides.
Muse Xeygeteth
Xoossi qasseka Muses, «Tani GODAA;
tani Ubbaa Dandayza Xoossa gidada Abrahaames, Yisaaqassinne Yaaqoobes qonccadis shin tani, ‹GODAA› geetettiza ta sunththan tanateththaa istta erisabeekke.
Qasse tani isttas istti bete gididi de7ida Kanaane biittaa isttas immanaas ta isttara caaqettadis.
Qasseka Gibxe asay aylle histti waayisida Isra7eele nayta waaso siyada ta gelida caaqo qaala qoppadis.

«Hessa gishshas neni Isra7eele naytas, ‹Tani GODAA; tani inttena Gibxe asaa qohoppe kessana; tani inttena istta aylleteththafekka goochcha kessana; qasse tani inttena ta gita wolqqaninne dumma dumma pirdan wozzana.
Tani inttena ta dere histtana; tani intte Xoossaa gidana. He wode ta inttena Gibxe asaa aylleteththafe kessida intte GODAA Mernaa Xoossaa gididayssa intte erana.
Qasse tani inttena Abrahaames, Yisaaqassinne Yaaqoobes immana gaada ta kushe denththada caaqqida biitta ehana; he biittaa tani inttes intte gade histta immana; tani GODAA› ga» gides.
Musey hessa Isra7eele naytas yootides shin istti ufays qanxxida gishshassinne iita aylleteththafe dendidayssan istta wozinay meqqida gishshas istti iza qaalaa siyibeettenna.
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse,
«Hee baada Gibxe kawaas, ‹Isra7eele nayta ne biittafe kessa yedda› gaada yoota» gides.
Gido attiin Musey GODAAS, «Isra7eele nayti tayssa siyontta ixxida shin tani doonay birshontta as gidishin kawoy ta gizayssa wostti siyanee?» gides.
GODAY Musenne Aaroone, «Biidi intte Isra7eele asaa Gibxeppe kessana mala tani inttena yeddidayssa Isra7eele asaassinne Gibxe kawos yootite» gi azazides.
Musenne Aaroone Zereththata
Hayssafe kaalli dizayti istta keeththa keeththa halaqata. Isra7eeles bayra naa Oroobeele attuma nayti, Heenooke, Paalu, Hexiroomenne Karme; haytanti Oroobeele qommota. Istta soo asata halaqati hayta.
Qasse Simoona attuma nayti, Yimu7eele, Yaamine, Ohaade, Yaakine, Xoohaarenne Kanaane biitta maccassatappe yelettida Sa7oole; hayti Simoona qommota.
Lewe baggati ba yeleta maaraa mala Gershoone, Qa7aatenne Meraare. Lewey 137 layth de7ides.
Gershoone attuma nayti ba qommon qommon Libinanne Shim7e geetetteetes.
Qaheete attuma nayti Amiraame, Yixihaare, Kebroonenne Uzi7eele. Qa7aatey 133 layth de7ides.
Meraare attuma nayti Mahilenne Mushe geetettizayta. Ba Yeleta maaran Lewe zareti haytantta.
Amiraamey ba aawaa michcheyo Yokaabedo machcho ekkides. Izakka izas Aaroonenne Muse yeladus. Amiraamey 137 layth de7ides.
Yixihaare attuma nayti, Qoore, Nefegenne Zikire.
Uzi7eele attuma nayti, Misha7eele, Elxafaanenne Siitire.
Aarooney Aminadaabe nayo, Ne7asoone michcheyo Elisheebo machcho ekkides. Histtiin iza izas Nadaabe, Abihu, El7ezeerenne Itamaare yeladus.
Qoore attuma nayti, Assire, Hilqaananne Abiyaasaafe; haytanti Qoore qommotas aawata.
Aaroone naa El7ezeerey Puti7eele naytappe issiniyo machcho ekkides; izakka izas Finihaase yeladus. Haytanti ba qommon qommon Lewe keeththa asaa halaqata.
GODAY, «Gibxe biittafe Isra7eele nayta istta cugan cugan kessite» giidi azaziday hayta Musenne Aaroone.
Isra7eele nayta Gibxe biittafe kessizayssa Gibxe kawaas yootidayti Musenne Aaroone.
GODAY Gibxen Muses yootiza wode izas,
«Tani GODAA; tani nees yootizayssa ubbaa neni Gibxe kawaas yoota» gides.
Musey qasse GODAAS, «Tani doonay birshontta as gidida gishshas kawoy tani yootizayssa wostti siyanee?» gides.
